name: addy-mcp
description: Manage your addy.io email aliases, recipients, domains, rules and blocklist.
long_description: Lets Claude manage your addy.io account: create, search and update aliases, manage recipients, usernames and custom domains, organise aliases with labels, build mail rules, and look into failed deliveries. Runs locally with your own API key, which is only ever sent to addy.io. Unofficial; not affiliated with addy.io.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Only allow tools that look things up; hide every tool that can change your account.

base_url.title: addy.io URL
base_url.description: Only change this for a self-hosted addy.io instance.

tools.name: get_account_details
tools.description: Get account details: username, plan/subscription, bandwidth used, default alias domain/format, limits, etc.

tools.name: get_api_token_details
tools.description: Get the name, creation date and expiry of the API token this server is using.

tools.name: get_account_notifications
tools.description: Get account notifications/announcements from addy.io.

tools.name: get_domain_options
tools.description: Get the domains available for creating aliases, plus the account's default alias domain and format.

tools.name: get_app_version
tools.description: Get the addy.io app version (only available on self-hosted instances).

tools.name: list_aliases
tools.description: List or search aliases. Results are paginated; the response includes `meta` with totals and page counts.

tools.name: get_alias
tools.description: Get a single alias, including its recipients, labels and statistics.

tools.name: create_alias
tools.description: Create a new alias. Use get_domain_options to see which domains are available.

tools.name: update_alias
tools.description: Update an alias's description, from name, or labels. Only the fields you pass are changed.

tools.name: delete_alias
tools.description: Delete an alias. It stops receiving mail but can be brought back with restore_alias.

tools.name: restore_alias
tools.description: Restore a deleted alias.

tools.name: forget_alias
tools.description: PERMANENTLY forget an alias: it is disassociated from the account and cannot be restored.

tools.name: set_alias_option
tools.description: Turn an alias option on or off (activate/deactivate, pin/unpin, limit reply/send to attached recipients).

tools.name: set_alias_recipients
tools.description: Replace the set of recipients an alias forwards to.

tools.name: set_alias_labels
tools.description: Replace the labels attached to an alias.

tools.name: bulk_alias_action
tools.description: Apply one action to up to 25 aliases at once (or fetch them with action='get').

tools.name: bulk_set_alias_recipients
tools.description: Replace the recipients of up to 25 aliases at once.

tools.name: bulk_set_alias_labels
tools.description: Replace the labels of up to 25 aliases at once.

tools.name: list_recipients
tools.description: List the account's recipients (the real mailboxes aliases forward to).

tools.name: get_recipient
tools.description: Get a single recipient and its settings.

tools.name: create_recipient
tools.description: Add a new recipient. addy.io emails it a verification link; it can't be used until verified.

tools.name: update_recipient
tools.description: Set a recipient's description.

tools.name: delete_recipient
tools.description: Delete a recipient. Aliases that used it fall back to the default recipient.

tools.name: resend_recipient_verification
tools.description: Resend the verification email for an unverified recipient.

tools.name: add_recipient_public_key
tools.description: Add a public GPG key to a recipient so forwarded mail can be encrypted.

tools.name: remove_recipient_public_key
tools.description: Remove a recipient's public GPG key (this also turns off encryption for it).

tools.name: set_recipient_option
tools.description: Turn a recipient option on or off.

tools.name: list_usernames
tools.description: List the account's usernames (each gives a subdomain like name.anonaddy.com for on-the-fly aliases).

tools.name: get_username
tools.description: Get a single username and its settings.

tools.name: create_username
tools.description: Create an additional username (counts against the plan's username limit).

tools.name: update_username
tools.description: Update a username's description, from name, or auto-create regex.

tools.name: delete_username
tools.description: Delete a username. Its aliases stop working.

tools.name: set_username_default_recipient
tools.description: Set (or clear) the default recipient for aliases on a username.

tools.name: set_username_option
tools.description: Turn a username option on or off.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List the custom domains connected to the account.

tools.name: get_domain
tools.description: Get a single custom domain and its settings/verification status.

tools.name: create_domain
tools.description: Add a custom domain. Its DNS must already have the TXT verification record addy.io shows in its dashboard.

tools.name: update_domain
tools.description: Update a custom domain's description, from name, or auto-create regex.

tools.name: delete_domain
tools.description: Delete a custom domain. Its aliases stop working.

tools.name: set_domain_default_recipient
tools.description: Set (or clear) the default recipient for aliases on a custom domain.

tools.name: check_domain_sending_records
tools.description: Check a custom domain's DNS records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, ...) for sending/replying from aliases.

tools.name: set_domain_option
tools.description: Turn a custom domain option on or off.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: List the labels used to organise aliases.

tools.name: get_label
tools.description: Get a single label.

tools.name: create_label
tools.description: Create a label for organising aliases.

tools.name: update_label
tools.description: Rename a label or change its colour.

tools.name: delete_label
tools.description: Delete a label (aliases are kept, just unlabelled).

tools.name: list_rules
tools.description: List all rules, in the order they are applied.

tools.name: get_rule
tools.description: Get a single rule with its conditions and actions.

tools.name: create_rule
tools.description: Create a rule that runs actions on emails matching conditions.

tools.name: update_rule
tools.description: Update a rule. Only the fields you pass change; the rest are kept from the current rule.

tools.name: delete_rule
tools.description: Delete a rule.

tools.name: reorder_rules
tools.description: Set the order rules are applied in.

tools.name: set_rule_active
tools.description: Activate or deactivate a rule.

tools.name: list_blocklist
tools.description: List blocked senders/domains, with how many emails each has blocked.

tools.name: add_to_blocklist
tools.description: Block mail from sender email addresses or whole domains, across all aliases.

tools.name: remove_from_blocklist
tools.description: Unblock blocklist entries by id (see list_blocklist).

tools.name: list_failed_deliveries
tools.description: List emails that addy.io failed to deliver (or quarantined).

tools.name: get_failed_delivery
tools.description: Get details of a failed delivery (sender, alias, bounce reason, ...).

tools.name: download_failed_delivery
tools.description: Download the raw email (.eml source) of a failed delivery, if addy.io stored it.

tools.name: resend_failed_delivery
tools.description: Retry delivering a failed or quarantined email.

tools.name: delete_failed_deliveries
tools.description: Delete failed delivery records (and any stored email).
